rooms.evidence: Native access/DM privacy tests and independent browser creation, direct picker, open/closed conversion, membership add/revoke and deletion all pass.

messages.evidence: Real create/update/delete, FTS, unreads, commit/rollback notification behavior was verified before the frontend cutover. PR5 focused tests cover explicit JSON HTTP resources, canonical editable rich text, authoritative reconnect snapshots, optimistic markers, stable pagination ordering and isolated JSON event dispatch; branch-head browser verification remains pending.

json_message_stream.evidence: Focused PHPUnit verifies the active Alpine/Echo bootstrap, five-event wiring, first-connect/reconnect authoritative snapshot ownership, canonical editable rich text, JSON mutation status/error contracts, server-rendered history, resource schema floor, attachment variants, authorization, transitive default/fallback asset closure and rollback isolation. The committed tests/Browser/pr5-json-stream.mjs harness is syntax/contract checked; its two-user browser and managed-Reverb frame runs remain pending.

sidebar.evidence: Pre-cutover populated-sidebar browser checks pass. The default path now emits a small private sidebar.changed JSON signal after commit and fetches authoritative static sidebar HTML; the fallback retains member-specific Turbo replacement. Default cross-tab delivery remains pending in the PR5 browser harness.

search.evidence: Independent real writes/updates verified FTS and sanitized populated search.

boosts.evidence: Independent persisted boost and redirect checks pass.

accounts.evidence: Independent browser verifies signup, role change, user deactivation/revocation, room access changes, bot create/key rotation/deactivation; 12 administration assertions passed.

bots.evidence: Native raw-body API, JSON/boost and no-loop webhook tests pass. Independent administration browser verifies bot creation, key rotation and deactivation.

uploads.evidence: Native metadata/checksum, image resize, attachment-only filename FTS, purge and nested/analysis rollback tests pass. Independent image upload/lightbox browser passes; actual 3840x2160 JPEG becomes 1200x675 JPEG. Wider media validation remains pending.

media.evidence: Real JPEG resizing and PNG analysis/thumbnail pass. Uploaded avatar HTTP200/WebP/public cache/304 and trusted default bot SVG pass. Exact installed ActiveStorage forced-binary/inline MIME arrays verified with signed responses for eight types; broader audio/video/PDF previews remain pending.

websockets.evidence: Independent pre-cutover live sockets reject forged/private streams and stop publication after logout. The default JSON room/sidebar subscriptions and payload confidentiality are focused-test verified; managed-Reverb capture for all five mutation families and sustained multi-tab behavior remain pending.

presence.evidence: Native clock-controlled two-tab tests verify 60-second TTL, 50-second refresh, present/absent counters and room_id read payload. Browser connection/composer passes; sustained socket action oracle pending.

webhooks.evidence: Independent local HTTP receiver verifies actual queued delivery and persisted native bot reply; PHPUnit verifies no callback loop.

jobs.evidence: Native durable auxiliary SQLite worker executes real delivery; PHPUnit checks afterCommit and rollback.

fresh_setup.evidence: Isolated blank native installation, first administrator and real login verified in independent browser (4 assertions).

backup.evidence: Actual disposable SQLite snapshot passes integrity_check; native jobs, upload files and VAPID keys included. Restore smoke test pending.

browser.evidence: Twenty-six independent browser assertions passed on the pre-PR5 frontend. They do not verify the replacement JSON/Alpine stream. The committed PR5 two-context harness is pending branch-head and post-merge execution.

benchmarks.evidence: Matched production HTTP runs against Ruby and Django: identical ordered windows, successful persisted body-bearing writes, FTS and SQLite integrity. Real resized JPEGs verified. Two paced runs admit all 100 sockets and fully deliver all 30 messages; no capacity limit inferred. Raw outputs remain ignored.
